text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and direct conclusion against driverless cars","quality":"stance clarity","description":"The essay states its position plainly and keeps that position consistent from introduction to conclusion."},{"evidence":"organized intro body conclusion with signposting","quality":"essay organization","description":"The essay is structured into distinct parts that make its line of argument easy to follow."},{"evidence":"uses article details to support claims about safety and liability","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay grounds its reasons in specific information from the source rather than relying only on general opinion."},{"evidence":"develops claims about laziness, accidents, and legal fault","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay gives multiple reasons and explains them instead of only mentioning points briefly."},{"evidence":"addresses supporters' arguments before rebutting them","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay shows awareness of the other side and responds to it with its own reasoning."},{"evidence":"maintains a mostly formal academic tone","quality":"tone control","description":"The essay sounds more like an argumentative essay because it stays relatively serious and essay-like throughout."}]}
